newsitem.title: USA: AOL reaches pact on pricing with 20 states.
newsitem.headline: AOL reaches pact on pricing with 20 states.

text.p: America Online Inc. reached an agreement with 20 state attorneys general over its new flat-rate pricing plan, with AOL agreeing to pay refunds to some subscribers, the Massachusetts attorney general's office said Thursday.
Last month, the nation's largest online service announced a new pricing plan of unlimited access for $19.95 a month, compared with its previous plan of $9.95 a month for five hours.

On Dec. 1, AOL automatically switched all subscribers to the new plan, unless they notified the company that they did not want the new plan. But many states said the practice was deceptive, because the change was implemented "in a manner that was misleading."
